structure: Flagged words are indexes into a global handle table, not section pointers

location.offset: object fields (e.g. PlacementReference +0x18, tfbPhysicsModel +0x48, type-52 node +0x34)

meaning: At load the flagged words become pointers to MEM1 addresses outside the resident section (0x80000000 -> 0x807AF3C0, 0x8000000A -> 0x806DFAF8, 0x800000CF -> 0x80990F44): the low bits index a global/shared resource table (materials, handles from other archives), so they must not be rebased when section 1 is relocated. Their exact table is UNKNOWN.

evidence.probe: ssa-archive experiment ptr-scan --dimensions (ptr-scan2.json, ptr-scan2-section1.bin) + igz fixups
